title: Syllabus Overview
notes: Unit 1: Biomolecules and Cell Biology · A: Botany · 15 teaching hours

• Biomolecules: Functions of carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, minerals, enzymes, and water.
  • Cell: Concepts of prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells, detailed structure of eukaryotic organelles (cell wall, membrane, mitochondria, plastids, ER, golgi bodies, lysosomes, ribosomes, nucleus, chromosomes, cilia, flagella, cell inclusions).
  • Cell division: Cell cycle, types (amitosis, mitosis, meiosis) and significance.
